newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Eltin raising A$31.9 mln by 1-4 rights.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Eltin raising A$31.9 mln by 1-4 rights.

text.p: Mining contractor Eltin Ltd said it will raise A$31.95 million by a one-for-four rights issue at A$2.20 per share to shareholders registered on November 12.
The issue price compared with Eltin's closing share market price of A$2.67 on Tuesday.
Eltin said it would issue about 14.53 million new shares.
It said it expects to at least maintain its current annual dividend of 10 cents a share on the enlarged capital but the new shares will not participate in its final dividend payable on November 8.
The funds raised will be used to meet future capital expenditure and to provide working capital, it said.
The issue is fully underwrittten by SBC Warburg Australia Ltd. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
